name: Aire Plastics
old_description: Welcome to Aire Plastics, a family owned and operated company dedicated to serving people like you since 1989.
about:
Aire Plastics is a family-owned injection molding company based in La Vernia, Texas, founded in 1989. The business traces its roots to 1982 when mold maker Ken Simms established Aire Masters of San Antonio after moving from Colorado. Following Simms' unexpected death in 1989, Terry Post, who owned an automotive repair business on family property in Adkins, Texas, acquired the plastics division and converted his garage into a production plant. Despite lacking prior molding experience, Post applied his background in high-precision boiler fabrication to deliver on-time parts to the company's original six customers.

Today the company operates a highly automated facility housing nine injection molding machines with press capacities ranging from 33 to 275 tons. The shop offers insert molding, over-molding, rapid tooling, prototyping, 3D modeling, and proof-of-concept development, along with secondary services such as ultrasonic welding, clam-shell packaging, packaging design, and direct-to-distribution shipping. A staff of 14 handles production runs from low-volume prototypes to high-volume orders.

Aire Plastics serves a mix of long-standing clients — including the original six accounts from 1989 — as well as inventors, entrepreneurs, and product developers seeking manufacturing support. The company emphasizes intellectual property protection, requiring non-disclosure agreements before project discussions, and provides resources for product development stages from ideation through manufacturing.

The business was built on Terry Post's determination to preserve the Simms family legacy and his precision-manufacturing discipline. That foundation, combined with a focus on long-term service records and on-time delivery, continues to differentiate the operation under the leadership of Vice President and General Manager Sean Post.
